record.context_brief: Image filtration versus mixed Hodge filtrations
record.original_question: Let f_t be a stable perturbation whose image Y_t has the natural increasing filtration 0=F_1 subset F_2 subset ... subset F_(n+1)=H_n(Y_t;Z), with successive quotients identified with alternating homology groups of multiple-point spaces D_k(f_t). What is the relationship between the corresponding cohomological filtration and the weight or Hodge filtrations in the mixed Hodge structure on the vanishing cohomology of images and discriminants?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f:(\mathbb{C}^n,S)\to(\mathbb{C}^{n+1},0)$ be a finitely $\mathcal{A}$-determined holomorphic map-germ, and let $f_t$ be a stable perturbation of $f$ with image $Y_t\subset\mathbb{C}^{n+1}$. For $k\ge 1$, denote by $D_k(f_t)$ the $k$-th multiple-point space of $f_t$ (the closure in $(\mathbb{C}^n)^k$ of the set of ordered $k$-tuples of pairwise distinct points having the same image under $f_t$), on which the symmetric group $S_k$ acts by permuting factors. Let $H_*^{\mathrm{alt}}(D_k(f_t);\mathbb{Z})$ denote the alternating part of its integral homology with respect to this $S_k$-action.

There is a natural increasing filtration
$$0=F_1\subset F_2\subset\cdots\subset F_{n+1}=H_n(Y_t;\mathbb{Z}),$$
with successive quotients $F_k/F_{k-1}$ canonically identified with $H_{n-k+1}^{\mathrm{alt}}(D_k(f_t);\mathbb{Z})$. Dualizing yields a corresponding decreasing filtration on the cohomology $H^n(Y_t;\mathbb{Z})$.

On the other hand, the vanishing cohomology of the image $Y_t$ (and similarly of the discriminant when $f$ is a map to $\mathbb{C}^p$ with $p\le n$) carries a canonical mixed Hodge structure, with its Deligne weight filtration $W_\bullet$ and Hodge filtration $F^\bullet$.

Problem: Determine the precise relationship between the cohomological filtration arising from the multiple-point spaces $D_k(f_t)$ and the weight filtration $W_\bullet$ and Hodge filtration $F^\bullet$ in the mixed Hodge structure on the vanishing cohomology of the image $Y_t$ and of the discriminant.
artifact.category_tag: Singularities of mappings and mixed Hodge structures
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution of the relationship between the image/multiple-point filtration and the weight or Hodge filtrations on vanishing cohomology of images and discriminants was found. The question appears to remain open as posed in the list of open problems on singularities of mappings.
